answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 28229 Country: India Title: IS GIVING BRIBE AND TAKING BRIBE ALLOWED. Question: MUFTI SAHEB IS GIVING BRIBE AND TAKING BRIBE ALLOWED. Answer ID: 28229 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 53/43/H=1432) It is not lawful but haram. However, it is allowed to give bribe in severe compulsion (you can enquire about its detail when you need it). But it is not lawful to take bribe in any case. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
